props.subTitle: Understanding Shiatsu
props.title: What Makes Shiatsu Different from Other Massage Techniques?
props.text: Shiatsu is a traditional Japanese bodywork technique that uses finger, thumb, and palm pressure on specific points across the body rather than long oil massage strokes. Often combined with gentle stretching, Shiatsu focuses on relieving muscle tension, encouraging natural body movement, and promoting overall physical balance.
props.feature1Text: Applies focused pressure to specific areas using fingers, thumbs, and palms.
props.feature2Text: Supports flexibility while helping muscles release built-up tension.

items.question: Is Shiatsu Massage performed with oil?
items.answer: Traditional Shiatsu is generally performed without massage oil. The treatment focuses on pressure point techniques and body movement rather than long gliding strokes.

items.question: Is Shiatsu suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. Pressure is always adjusted according to your comfort, making Shiatsu suitable for both first-time guests and experienced massage enthusiasts.

items.question: What is the difference between Shiatsu and Deep Tissue Massage?
items.answer: Shiatsu focuses on pressure points and gentle stretching using fingers and palms, while Deep Tissue Massage works deeper into muscles using slow pressure and muscle-specific techniques.

items.question: Can Shiatsu help reduce stress?
items.answer: Many guests choose Shiatsu because the slow rhythm and controlled pressure encourage both physical relaxation and a calmer state of mind.

items.question: Can Shiatsu be combined with other spa treatments?
items.answer: Yes. Shiatsu is often combined with body treatments or other wellness services as part of a longer spa experience.

items.question: Is shiatsu massage painful?
items.answer: Shiatsu massage can feel firm or intense when pressure is applied to tense areas, but it should remain comfortable. Our therapist can adjust the pressure based on your preference.

items.question: What is shiatsu massage good for?
items.answer: Shiatsu massage may help relieve muscle tension, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. It can also help improve flexibility and overall body comfort.

items.question: When should you not do shiatsu massage?
items.answer: Shiatsu massage may not be suitable if you have certain medical conditions, injuries, or are recovering from surgery. If you are unsure whether it is right for you, consult a healthcare professional before your session.
